mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in new housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for goods and services, which typically precedes positive equity market performance as corporate earnings growth accelerates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS growth rate above 0.5% month-over-month) and the federal funds rate is declining (FEDFUNDS change > -0.25% in the past month), it signals a favorable environment for corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that typically precedes corporate wage pressures and higher inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 470,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recovery when RSAFS exceeds 470,000 million dollars, or the Rank IC remains below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) indicates persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
